---
title: "How the UK sources join"
---

## Summary

Companies House is not the only free UK source of company data — it is the spine that the
others attach to. The Gazette, HM Land Registry, payment-practices reports, public-procurement
records, charity registers, the overseas-entities register and the FCA register each add a
different column to the same picture, and most of them join to a company on its **company
number**. The catch is rarely price: most of these are free. The catch is **licences** (some
forbid republishing) and **matching** (some sources carry the company number cleanly, others
only sometimes). This page lists each source with what it adds, how it joins, how to get it,
whether it can be republished, its known problems, who has used it before, and where this
project stands on it.

A second, blunter point sits underneath the map: some of the most predictive data **cannot** be
got this way at all. Bank-credit behaviour, trade-payment histories and court judgments are
private or paid, and no amount of open-data engineering reconstructs them. That boundary is set
out at the end.

## Details

Each source below joins to Companies House mostly on the company number. "Our status" uses four
values: **Done**, **In progress**, **Planned**, **Not planned**. Match-quality and access
claims carry a **[Checked]** / **[Estimated]** label; everything traces to deck slides 6–8 and
their notes (`docs/source-material/companies-house-accounts-deck.md` and
`companies-house-accounts-notes.md`), the project plan (`docs/plan.md`), the README, and the
literature queue (`literature/open-company-uk-source-queue-2026-08.md`).

### Companies House itself

Companies House is several sources in one. Treat each product separately.

**Register (Basic Company Data)**

- *What it adds:* the spine — name, number, status, registered office, SIC codes, incorporation
  and accounts-due dates for every live company.
- *Join key / match:* the company number *is* the key. **[Checked]**
- *Access & licence:* free monthly CSV; OGL v3.0, republishable (personal data aside).
- *Known problems:* live companies only, no history — reconstructing past states means keeping
  your own monthly copies.
- *Our status:* **Done** — used as population context and the stratification spine in the
  [indicator validation](../indicators/validation.qmd).

**Accounts bulk data**

- *What it adds:* the actual financial figures — balance-sheet items, employee counts — tagged
  in iXBRL/XML. See [the accounts guide](accounts-data.qmd).
- *Join key / match:* company number, inside each filing. **[Checked]**
- *Access & licence:* free daily/monthly ZIPs back to 2008; OGL v3.0. The financial facts are
  not personal data, so a derived financials dataset can be published.
- *Known problems:* electronically filed only; mostly balance sheets; the API returns no parsed
  numbers, so you must parse the filings yourself.
- *Our status:* **Done** — the published [2014–2026 accounts **WIDE** dataset](../datasets/accounts.qmd)
  (the per-fact LONG table is withdrawn pending a dimension-aware privacy filter).

**PSC (persons with significant control)**

- *What it adds:* ownership and control — who owns or controls each company, and declared
  statements where no PSC is identified.
- *Join key / match:* company number; person-level linkage is fuzzy (no stable person ID —
  see [the PSC page](../datasets/psc.qmd)). **[Checked]**
- *Access & licence:* free daily JSON snapshot; OGL v3.0, but it contains personal data, so this
  project publishes **code only**.
- *Known problems:* only today's snapshot is served; corrections over time are lost unless you
  archive. One-shot snapshot, not an event log.
- *Our status:* **In progress** — recon complete, extractor in design.

**Officers (directors and secretaries)**

- *What it adds:* who runs the company; appointment/resignation history; ECCTA identity
  verification fields.
- *Join key / match:* company number via the API; person linkage is fuzzy. **[Checked]**
- *Access & licence:* the *bulk* officers product is on request only, not a public download;
  the per-company API is free. Personal data — code only.
- *Our status:* **Done (via API, in the indicator pipeline)** — officer churn and
  identity-verification attributes are derived per company; the bulk product is **Not planned**.

**APIs (REST / Streaming / Document)**

- *What it adds:* current, per-company state and the filed documents themselves.
- *Access & licence:* free key; rate-limited (~600 req/5min per key, **[Not verified]** — see
  [Companies House guide](companies-house.qmd)).
- *Known problems:* no parsed financial figures; no bulk history.
- *Our status:* **Done** — the indicator pipeline is API-first for freshness-sensitive state.

### The Gazette

- *What it adds:* official insolvency and strike-off notices with dates — winding-up petitions,
  liquidations, strike-offs. Good for **outcome labels** and, more usefully, **timing**: how
  far ahead of a winding-up petition does a register or accounts signal appear?
- *Join key / match:* company number present in notices. **[Checked]**
- *Access & licence:* free official API (JSON), paged; free web viewing is OGL. A separate
  commercial **Data Service** exists — investigate a reproducible open acquisition route before
  planning ingestion.
- *Known problems:* separate the free OGL route from the paid Data Service.
- *Prior work:* Transparency International UK used incorporation dates and notices as red flags
  (see [prior work](../evidence/prior-work.qmd)).
- *Our status:* **Planned** — the next specified external integration (`docs/plan.md`, README).

### HM Land Registry — company property ownership {#hm-land-registry-company-property-ownership}

- *What it adds:* which UK and overseas companies own property in England & Wales — asset
  ownership, and a bridge to overseas owners.
- *Join key / match:* company registration number. **[Checked]**
- *Access & licence:* free monthly CSV (free since November 2017, account and licence required),
  historical files via API. **The licence does not allow republishing** — so, as with PSC,
  publish code only.
- *Known problems:* republishing restriction; coverage is England & Wales.
- *Prior work:* Private Eye (2015) → Who Owns England → TaxPolicy.org.uk (January 2026), which
  cross-checked Land Registry against the overseas-entities register and published its method.
- *Our status:* **Planned**.

### Payment-practices reporting

- *What it adds:* the only open signal on **payment behaviour** — large firms' average days to
  pay, share of invoices paid late, and standard terms. This is the open stand-in for the
  trade-payment data credit agencies sell privately.
- *Join key / match:* company number on every report. **[Checked]**
- *Access & licence:* all reports downloadable; open.
- *Known problems:* **large companies only** — it does not cover the small/micro majority.
- *Our status:* **Planned**.

### Contracts Finder / Find a Tender

- *What it adds:* public contracts and winning suppliers — public-sector exposure, and very new
  suppliers winning contracts (a documented red flag).
- *Join key / match:* **sometimes** — supplier identifiers are inconsistent, so matching needs
  work. **[Estimated]** (contract→company-number match quality is not yet measured here).
- *Access & licence:* bulk, Open Contracting Data Standard; open.
- *Prior work:* Transparency International UK ("Track and Trace", "Behind the Masks"); Open
  Ownership has combined PSC with procurement data.
- *Our status:* **Planned**.

### Charity registers (Charity Commission, OSCR, CCNI) {#charity-registers-charity-commission-oscr-ccni}

- *What it adds:* the non-profit segment — many charities are also companies and carry a company
  number; finances and trustees.
- *Join key / match:* **mostly** — most charitable companies carry a company number.
  **[Estimated]**.
- *Access & licence:* bulk downloads; open.
- *Prior work:* David Kane / 360Giving's **Find that Charity** already links 16 sources and
  ~660,000 non-profits (the same author wrote `ixbrlparse`).
- *Our status:* **Not planned as an own build** — reuse Find that Charity if a charity join is
  needed.

### Register of Overseas Entities

- *What it adds:* foreign owners of UK property and their beneficial owners — ownership beyond
  the UK, and the bridge between Land Registry and ownership.
- *Join key / match:* its own overseas-entity ID; links to HMLR. **[Checked]**
- *Access & licence:* held at Companies House, free.
- *Prior work:* TaxPolicy.org.uk's 2026 cross-check (above).
- *Our status:* **Planned**.

### FCA register

- *What it adds:* which firms are FCA-authorised — a flag for regulated financial firms.
- *Join key / match:* **partly** — not a clean company-number key for all records. **[Checked]**
- *Access & licence:* API only, ~10 requests per 10 seconds, so no practical bulk copy.
- *Known problems:* rate limit makes bulk reconstruction impractical; use as a lookup flag.
- *Our status:* **Planned**.

### Data you can't easily get {#data-you-cant-easily-get}

Some of the most predictive company data is private or paid, and no open-data pipeline
reconstructs it. State the gap plainly rather than imply open data covers everything.

| Source | Why it's hard to get | Terms / price (indicative, dated) |
|---|---|---|
| **Bank credit data on small firms** | Shared by designated banks only with four designated credit agencies (Experian, Equifax, Creditsafe, D&B) under the Commercial Credit Data Sharing scheme | Small Business, Enterprise and Employment Act 2015; D&B added 2019. Not public. **[Checked]** |
| **Trade-payment behaviour** | Days-beyond-terms and payment scores built from agencies' own supplier networks | Proprietary, paid. **[Checked]** |
| **County court judgments (CCJs)** | Register of Judgments via Registry Trust; a strong distress signal missing from open data | Searches from ~£10 each; bulk licences for agencies. *Indicative, Registry Trust / TrustOnline.* **[Estimated]** |
| **Full profit & loss for small firms** | Filed with HMRC alongside the corporation-tax return, not with Companies House | Confidential. **[Checked]** |
| **Official business microdata** | ONS business-register extracts | Accredited researchers only, via secure research services. **[Checked]** |
| **Tax records** | HMRC Datalab | Approved research projects only. **[Checked]** |

Source: deck slide 8 and its notes. The analytical consequence — that an open model can match
commercial products on *describing* companies but not on *predicting non-payment* — is
developed on [the market page](../landscape/market.qmd).

> **What it means for you.** Plan joins around the company number, budget effort for licences
> and matching rather than for access fees, and be honest in any model about the private layer
> you cannot see. Left off deliberately: the HMRC VAT check (one number at a time), the
> individual insolvency register (personal data), and food-hygiene ratings (no company numbers).
